ns0:media.alt: This figure shows two table that each have one column. The table on the left has the header “x” and lists the numbers negative 3, negative 2, negative 1, 0, 1, 2, and 3. The table on the right has the header “x to the fourth power” and lists the numbers 0, 1, 16, and 81. There are arrows starting at numbers in the x table and pointing towards numbers in the x to the fourth power table. The first arrow goes from negative 3 to 81. The second arrow goes from negative 2 to 16. The third arrow goes from negative 1 to 1. The fourth arrow goes from 0 to 0. The fifth arrow goes from 1 to 1. The sixth arrow goes from 2 to 16. The seventh arrow goes from 3 to 81.
